# India Today

> > India's leading news magazine covering national and international affairs, cricket, politics, education, and investigative journalism.

India Today is a comprehensive news platform providing coverage of major events including ICC Cricket World Cup, T20 tournaments, Indian Assembly Elections across states like Bihar, Maharashtra, and Tamil Nadu, university rankings, and in-depth investigative reports. The publication also features lifestyle content, horoscopes, and hosts major events like the Indo UAE Conclave.

## Key Topics

- India Today Magazine
- ICC Cricket World Cup
- T20 World Cup 2026
- Indian Assembly Elections
- Bihar Elections 2025
- Maharashtra Elections
- Tamil Nadu Elections
- University Rankings 2025
- Cricket Teams (India, Pakistan, Australia, England, South Africa)
- Investigative Journalism
- Indo UAE Conclave
- Indian History
- Higher Education
- Sports Coverage

## Major News Coverage & Features

- [Cover Story](https://www.indiatoday.in/cover-story): Weekly magazine cover stories on Iran, Middle East, India-Bangladesh relations
- [Investigation](https://www.indiatoday.in/investigation): Investigative journalism on cattle smuggling, exam fraud, and espionage
- [Anniversary](https://www.indiatoday.in/anniversary): India Today's 49th anniversary special issue covering milestones
- [Indo UAE Conclave 2025](https://www.indiatoday.in/conclave-indo-uae/2025): India Today Group's Indo UAE business conclave in Dubai, May 15, 2025

## Cricket Coverage

- [World Cup 2023](https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/world-cup): ICC Cricket World Cup 2023 coverage with live scores and schedules
- [T20 World Cup 2026](https://www.indiatoday.in/sports/t20-world-cup): ICC T20 World Cup 2026 schedule, fixtures, scores, and team coverage
- [T20 World Cup Australia Squad 2026](https://www.indiatoday.in/live-score/cricket/teams/t20-world-cup-13203-australia-1): Australia cricket squad led by Mitchell Marsh for T20 World Cup 2026
- [T20 World Cup Pakistan Squad 2026](https://www.indiatoday.in/live-score/cricket/teams/t20-world-cup-13203-pakistan-6): Pakistan cricket team roster for ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026
- [T20 World Cup Zimbabwe Squad 2026](https://www.indiatoday.in/live-score/cricket/teams/t20-world-cup-13203-zimbabwe-10): Zimbabwe cricket team squad for ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026

## Indian Elections & Politics

- [Bihar Election Schedule 2025](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections/assembly/schedule): Bihar Assembly Election 2025 complete schedule with polling dates
- [Maharashtra Assembly Election Results](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections/assembly/maharashtra/constituency-list): Maharashtra Assembly Election 2024 constituency-wise winning candidates
- [Tamil Nadu Election 2026 Constituencies](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections/assembly/tamil-nadu/constituency-list): Complete list of Tamil Nadu Assembly Election 2026 constituencies

## Education & Rankings

- [Best Universities of India Rankings 2025](https://www.indiatoday.in/best-universities-of-india-rankings-2025): Rankings of India's top universities featuring NLSIU Bengaluru, IIT Delhi
- [Design and Creative Arts Courses in Australia](https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today/study-abroad-courses/australia/design-and-creative-arts): Study guide for Design & Creative Arts programs at Australian universities

## Lifestyle & Culture

- [Leisure](https://www.indiatoday.in/leisure): Arts, culture, and entertainment coverage including theatre and exhibitions
- [Historical News](https://www.indiatoday.in/history-of-it): Indian history articles covering military, political, and war history

## Optional

- [Horoscopes](https://www.indiatoday.in/horoscopes): Daily, weekly, monthly horoscope predictions for all zodiac signs
